testing.context: **Testing:** I ran `pytest` from the repo root and all 6 tests passed. `tests/test_pagination.py` already covered this bug (`test_partial_last_page_is_returned` and `test_page_count_rounds_up`), so I added no new tests. I did not confirm that those two tests failed before the fix.

side_effects.detail: Any caller of page_count now receives the rounded-up value
